title: Grand Singapore, Malaysia and Bali Holiday
alt: Gardens by the Bay Supertrees lit up in Singapore
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Singapore
stops.subtitle: Singapore to Sentosa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Bencoolen hotel, five minutes on foot from the metro

activities.name: Night Safari with tram ride
activities.description: The world's first nocturnal zoo, with a tram ride through seven habitats and walking trails where the animals are at their most active.

activities.name: Sentosa cable car sky pass
activities.description: Two cable car lines over the harbour and across Sentosa, the easiest way to see the island and the port from above.

activities.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
activities.description: One of the largest aquariums anywhere, with a ten metre viewing panel, reef sharks, manta rays and forty five thousand animals.

activities.name: Madame Tussauds Singapore
activities.description: Wax figures, the Images of Singapore ride and the Spirit of Singapore boat ride, all on the Imbiah lookout at Sentosa.

activities.name: Wings of Time show
activities.description: An evening show on Siloso beach with water jets, lasers and fire, staged over the sea at the end of your Sentosa day.

activities.name: Singapore sightseeing tour
activities.description: A half day tour past Merlion Park, the Marina Bay waterfront, Chinatown and the colonial quarter, with a guide on a shared coach.

activities.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
activities.description: The observation deck fifty seven floors above Marina Bay, with the city, the port and the Gardens by the Bay domes below you.

program.name: Singapore
program.description: Three nights in the city with a night safari, a full Sentosa day of cable cars, the aquarium and Wings of Time, and the Marina Bay SkyPark.

stops.name: Kuala Lumpur
stops.subtitle: Kuala Lumpur to Genting and Sunway
stops.hotel: Metro Hotel Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Bukit Bintang hotel in the middle of the shopping and food streets

activities.name: Kuala Lumpur sightseeing tour
activities.description: The King's palace gates, the National Monument, Merdeka Square and the old railway station, with a photo stop at the towers.

activities.name: Genting Highlands and Batu Caves
activities.description: A private day up to the hill resort by cable car, with the theme park and casino floor, and the Batu Caves temple steps on the way back.

activities.name: Petronas Twin Towers tickets
activities.description: Entry to the sky bridge and the observation deck on the eighty sixth floor, with the city spread out on both sides.

activities.name: Sunway Lagoon park
activities.description: Six parks on one ticket with water slides, a surf beach, a wildlife section and the longest suspension bridge in the country.

program.name: Kuala Lumpur
program.description: Three nights in Bukit Bintang, with a city tour, a hill day at Genting and Batu Caves, the Petronas towers and a full day at Sunway Lagoon.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Kintamani and Tanah Lot
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet pool hotel walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in Bali to finish, with a coffee plantation day up to Kintamani and a temple run that ends at Tanah Lot for sunset.

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Three countries, nine nights, and a main meal every day. For a family of four this is the package that works out cheapest.
expert.tip: Sentosa is a long day, so start with the cable car and finish with Wings of Time. In Kuala Lumpur we keep Sunway Lagoon for after Genting, because the children sleep through the drive back.

summary: Ten days with return flights across Singapore, Malaysia and Bali: a night safari and a full Sentosa day, the Marina Bay SkyPark, Genting and Batu Caves, the Petronas towers, Sunway Lagoon, then Kintamani and sunset at Tanah Lot.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 9 nights with daily breakfast and one main meal daily; private airport and city transfers; Night Safari; Sentosa cable car, S.E.A. Aquarium, Madame Tussauds and Wings of Time; Singapore sightseeing; Marina Bay Sands SkyPark; Kuala Lumpur city tour; Genting and Batu Caves; Petronas tickets; Sunway Lagoon; Kintamani tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot tour.
not_included: Not included: the Singapore to Kuala Lumpur and Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar flights, which we can add; visa fees; travel insurance; personal expenses.
